title: Firelit profile — celestial refinement
prompt: Use case: style-transfer / logo-brand. Edit target: the supplied Ukai Firelit Profile cormorant logo. User request: make this existing mark a bit more esoteric. Preserve the immediately recognizable cormorant identity, right-facing upright S-curved neck, long slender hooked beak, folded wing, feet and long tapering tail, composition, ink-black silhouette and warm amber firelit edge. Keep the warm ivory background. Introduce a restrained, refined alchemical-emblem feeling: a delicate incomplete amber solar arc behind the bird's head, clearly separated from the neck, and one tiny four-point guiding star just above the beak. The arc is a distant celestial graphic, not an object worn by the bird. Let the existing ivory folded-wing cut become a slightly more deliberate elegant crescent, while retaining the original wing silhouette. Preserve the simplicity and strong solid masses of the source. A contemporary occult bookplate distilled into a usable professional developer-tool logo; mysterious, quiet, dignified, not sinister. Only a small increase in ornament. Two flat ink colors, black and warm amber, on warm ivory; crisp vector-like curves, generous negative space. One single emblem, no typography or mockup or layout sheet. Absolutely NO neck ring, collar, band crossing the neck, rope, tether, chain, cage or restraint. No pentagrams, runes, invented script, obvious religious symbols, full ornamental border, sprawling sacred geometry, detailed engraving, gradients, glow, 3D, textures or background scenery.
